# Device fixture provenance

All JSON files here are **original synthetic fixtures**, written for AppRivet. They are not captured from a Mac or physical device, and cannot establish Xcode compatibility. IDs, names and values are invented. Fields named DO-NOT-EXPORT exercise omission of sensitive metadata.

The structures were informed by Apple's Xcode 27 release notes, the public first-hand field mapping in auto-mobile issue 8623, and the documented devicectl envelope used by Flutter's own tests. No tool implementation or fixture was copied. See docs/DEVICES.md for sources and the live acceptance matrix. The modern physical record is especially provisional: sparse metadata must remain unknown, never become an install authorization.
